fusions.name: Seam Runner
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Fires a bolt that hits the first enemy in its path for 8 damage and leaves it [Exposed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Pinpoint Cast
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 24 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and ignores the target's armour.

fusions.name: Through the Gap
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 5 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3s after you use it.

fusions.name: Stitched Pace
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, your next strike gains 15% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.
